title: Day 779: Man Shot Inside Home in Chula Vista, Southwest Culiacán
detail: Around 3:30 PM on Thursday, September 10, 2026, armed subjects attacked a home on the streets Juan M. Banderas and Rubén Martí, near the Conalep campus, in the Chula Vista sector of southwest Culiacán. A man identified as Martín, 32, was struck by gunfire in the abdomen. He was first taken by private vehicle to a downtown Red Cross station for initial treatment before being transferred by ambulance to a hospital. State investigative police and the Fiscalía mobilized to the scene to process evidence.

title: Day 779: Armed Pursuit Through Los Mezcales and Loma de Rodriguera Leaves Two Men Wounded
detail: Shortly before 11:00 PM on Thursday, September 10, 2026, authorities were alerted to heavy gunfire at Avenida Álvaro Obregón and Calle Benjamín J. López in the Los Mezcales neighborhood of north Culiacán. Army personnel and state police recovered numerous rifle and handgun casings at the scene. The pursuit continued roughly a kilometer to Avenida Primera Norte in the Loma de Rodriguera sector, where officers found two wounded men inside a black Jeep Cherokee. The Red Cross transported both to hospital; their conditions were not disclosed. State investigative authorities documented the scene.

media.caption: Coverage of the armed pursuit and shooting in Culiacán's Los Mezcales and Loma de Rodriguera sectors, September 10, 2026
